proof_scope: Supporting ideal-list, abstract-procedure and integer lemmas only; no complete source-game security proof.
trusted_stack: EasyCrypt logic and official libraries; Why3 and selected Z3 SMT proofs. No transitive library-axiom minimization or full library rebuild is claimed.

files.scope: Fixed candidate lists supplied before two independent uniform keys; not adaptive source-transcript security.

declarations.name: uniform_atom_bound
declarations.statement:
(n x : int) :
  0 < n => mu1 (dinter 0 (n-1)) x <= 1%r / n%r.

declarations.name: one_seed_hit_bound
declarations.statement:
(n : int) (candidates : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  mu (dinter 0 (n-1)) (mem candidates)
  <= (size candidates)%r * (1%r / n%r).

declarations.name: two_seed_hit_bound
declarations.statement:
(n : int) (prefixes suffixes : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  mu (dinter 0 (n-1) `*` dinter 0 (n-1))
    (fun (keys : int * int) => keys.`1 \in prefixes \/ keys.`2 \in suffixes)
  <= (size prefixes + size suffixes)%r * (1%r / n%r).

declarations.name: key_blind_game_bound
declarations.statement:
(n : int) (prefixes suffixes : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  phoare [KeyBlind.sample : arg = (prefixes,suffixes,n) ==> res]
    <= ((size prefixes + size suffixes)%r * (1%r / n%r)).

files.scope: Two abstract reflexive routing equivalences and three integer resource inequalities; not the complete adapter or Rust model.

declarations.name: secret_adapter_equiv
declarations.statement:
(C <: PRIVATE) :
  equiv [Adapter(C).secret ~ Adapter(C).secret :
    ={arg, glob C} ==> ={res, glob C}].

declarations.name: nonce_adapter_equiv
declarations.statement:
(C <: PRIVATE) :
  equiv [Adapter(C).nonce ~ Adapter(C).nonce :
    ={arg, glob C} ==> ={res, glob C}].
